candidates.claim: The read-only SNMP community on rtr-01 has no ACL bound to it, so it is not restricted to MGMT hosts as the management policy requires.
candidates.remediation: Bind the rtr-01 SNMP community to an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts, such as the existing SNMP_NMS ACL limited to 10.10.99.50.

candidates.claim: The rtr-01 SNMP community line differs from the approved baseline: the baseline bound it to ACL SNMP_NMS, but the current snapshot has no ACL.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change by restoring the SNMP_NMS ACL binding on the rtr-01 community or formally approving the removal.
